verdict.rationale: USCIS publishes a documented developer platform (Torch) with onboarding, team accounts, a sandbox, and production keys. Through it, the Case Status API and the FOIA/PA request-and-status API can be driven programmatically. However, the core product action, filing immigration forms and paying fees, has no API: online filing runs only through the account-based myUSCIS web interface. So only status lookup and FOIA requests are API-drivable. Missing for 10: filing/submission API, fee payment API, address change and account management via API, G-28 representative workflows via API, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the Torch APIs.
